messages:
Marta (Docs): Heads up - I ran a link sweep and found ~8 dead links under the 'API reference' section (mostly old param names and a moved page). I'll open a patch to fix redirects and update affected snippets.
Eli (Product): Thanks. Any user-facing impacts already reported?
Marta (Docs): Not yet, just caught by our link checker CI. The worst is a redirect loop on docs/quickstart/auth which should point to docs/guides/authentication now.
Noah (Eng): That redirect loop sounds like a buggy rewrite rule in the site config. @eng-platform can we get a quick look?
Priya (Docs): I'll bundle the site-config rewrite fix in the PR and include a note in the release notes that we fixed the auth redirect loop. Also updating the changelog to mention the API reference cleanup.
link-checker-bot: link-checker found 8 broken links in docs v2.1. See report: https://ci/reports/link-check-1752.html
Marta (Docs): Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301 - includes redirect fix, updated snippets, and a tiny note in the glossary where 'API reference' had an outdated call example.
Noah (Eng): I'll run the site-config review. If we need to ship the rewrite before the merge, ping me and I can cut a hotfix deploy.
Eli (Product): Let's make sure the changelog entry is explicit so users find the new auth page. Maybe include an example CLI snippet for service account flow.
Marta (Docs): Good idea, adding a quick CLI example.
Priya (Docs): After merge, I'll run a quick follow-up deploy and coordinate a tiny in-product tooltip in the console linking to the updated auth guide.
Marta (Docs): Thanks team. I'll ask for 1 review from eng-platform and 1 from product and merge after green CI.
